zh-Hans: 本轮重点：音乐、二维设计与媒体工作台整体布局；五线谱／简谱、多乐器演奏音频加入编曲与双 Deck DJ；图片／视频工具、复合片段、色彩与人声分离；40 类正文内原生图表；SVG 预览；可直接查看的文件差异；文件／回收站批量管理；原生 Git 与 GitHub 协作；局域网发现、连接历史和本地 Linux 网络改进；PCB 元件库、化学、LaTeX 原生排版与按文章补齐依赖、文档助手、苹果同步与任务状态。请检查此前报告的问题、保存重开、预览和助手操作。云端服务需自行配置；人声分离使用兼容本地模型或已配置服务。原生 USB 串口驱动暂不包含。
en-US: Focus on redesigned music, 2D design and media layouts; staff/numbered notation, multi-instrument performance audio on the timeline and dual-deck DJ; image/video tools, compound clips, color and vocal separation; 40 inline native chart types; SVG previews; readable file diffs; file/Trash batch actions; native Git and GitHub collaboration; LAN discovery, connection history and local Linux networking; PCB libraries, chemistry, native LaTeX typesetting with document-specific resource downloads, document assistants, Apple sync and task status. Check previously reported issues, saving/reopening, previews and assistant actions. Cloud services require your own configuration. Vocal separation uses a compatible local model or configured service. Native USB serial drivers are not included.
